name: One Piece - Unlimited Cruise SP
description:
"One Piece Unlimited Cruise Episode 1 & Episode 2" is now available on Nintendo 3DS with the addition of the Marineford edition!
■Compatible with autostereoscopic vision, you can operate Luffy and his friends on a great adventure through a field that is more powerful and realistic than ever before.
You aim for the treasure hidden on the islands while defeating the enemies that suddenly appear on the stage. You can develop items and dishes using the materials you get along the way, and you can also experience pirate life on the Thousand Sunny. Standing in front of Luffy and his friends are characters that appeared in the original work. The battle with them is also reproduced with a powerful force that approaches the player.
■Adding surprising new elements!!
New characters such as the Seven Warlords of the Sea ``Boa Hancock'' and the Revolutionary Army ``Ivankov'' are joining the battle one after another. Also included is a new mode exclusive to this game that allows you to relive the fierce battles of Marineford.
■Full play volume
The interface has been completely redesigned with button operations and support for upper and lower screens! Evolved to make it easier for players to play! Combined with the main game and new modes, the play volume is over 50 hours!
